articles.title: Jude Bellingham: England's Secret Super-Flexible Star!
articles.summary: Jude Bellingham played a super-flexible role in England's 2-0 win over Panama, filling in for injured teammate Declan Rice. Coach Thomas Tuchel says Bellingham is key to his clever game plan.

articles.title: Labour Party Rallies Behind Andy Burnham as Next Leader!
articles.summary: After Prime Minister Keir Starmer quit, senior Labour members say the party is uniting behind Andy Burnham to be the new leader. They want to skip a long contest and quickly get to work.
